title: Jellyfish in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bell' cx='50%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ad5'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e8559f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b02d78'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tentacles -->
  <path d='M30 62 q-4 10 2 18 q5 7 1 14' fill='none' stroke='#c85fb0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 64 q-3 11 3 19 q4 7 0 13' fill='none' stroke='#e07ac8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 64 q3 11 -3 19 q-4 7 0 13' fill='none' stroke='#e07ac8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 62 q4 10 -2 18 q-5 7 -1 14' fill='none' stroke='#c85fb0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bell -->
  <path d='M26 56 q0 -34 24 -34 q24 0 24 34 q-6 6 -12 2 q-6 6 -12 0 q-6 6 -12 0 q-6 6 -12 0 q-6 4 -12 -2 z' fill='url(#bell)'/>
  <!-- bell highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='34' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#ffc2e6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='40' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffc2e6' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='4.5' fill='#40123a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='4.5' fill='#40123a'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='46.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='46.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M47 54 q3 3 6 0' fill='none' stroke='#40123a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf band -->
  <path d='M28 58 q22 8 44 0 l1 6 q-23 8 -46 0 z' fill='#3fd0c9'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M66 62 q10 1 12 8 q-6 2 -9 -1 q-4 -3 -5 -6 z' fill='#2fae9f'/>
  <path d='M67 63 q9 0 11 6' fill='none' stroke='#8ef0e8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d='M34 59.5 l3 5' stroke='#8ef0e8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M46 61 l2 5' stroke='#8ef0e8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M58 61 l2 5' stroke='#8ef0e8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
